Delivery was arranged two days before the event. The old delivery address was 14 Mill Street. Morgan handled the warehouse key. The attendance estimate of forty was never a count of actual arrivals.

2027-02-03 | Lantern exploratory meeting | Superseded planning. A small morning event was suggested, along with a separate evening reception. The budget was discussed as a range, not a spend authorization. Notes proposed using whichever supplier had stock. A sample from Cedar Supply had the wrong label and was returned. No current event date was signed off in this entry.

2027-02-11 | Finch demonstration | Closed. A projector reservation showed tentative through the day before the event. The team kept an alternative room in reserve, then released it when the first booking was confirmed. No room was considered booked merely because it appeared in a draft itinerary. Delivery staff needed a loading window, not the private door code.

2027-02-17 | Copper debrief | Closed. The owner asked for short written status updates and no duplicate reminders for the same obligation. A vendor's automatic acknowledgment did not count as answering the actual invoice question. The team used task IDs to distinguish a reopened issue from a second copy. This note does not grant authority to send messages or spend money.

They had different email domains and neither could act for the other. A nickname in a forwarded message was insufficient to merge their records. A later explicit owner link would be a stronger basis than name similarity.

The team did not repair or overwrite the inventory to make the read work. They retained the source revision so a downstream report could identify which snapshot it used.
